_about: Acetonitrile (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetonitrile, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Q. Li, L. Cao, X. Sun, P. Liu, B. Wang, Isobaric Vapor  -  Liquid Equilibrium for Ethyl Acetate + Acetonitrile +  1  -  Butyl-3-methylimidazolium Hexa  fl  uorophosphate at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 1112-1116
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0040. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.51 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
